column2: Pipe sleeves shall be provided where water service pipes penetrate foundation walls or floor slabs to protect against corrosion of the pipe and allow clearance for expansion, contraction and settlement. The sleeve shall form a watertight bond with the wall or floor slab. The annular space between the pipe and the sleeve shall be resiliently sealed watertight.
Where water service piping is plastic, the wall sleeve shall not be less than five feet long extended outside beyond the wall to undisturbed earth or other equivalent support.
